role: Independent Yggdrasil research contributor; Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work PR #1278 is the sole accepted-learner coordinator
research_question: Can existing fixed-class native cumulative GF2 learners discover the factual regime cue that resolves contradictory A vs B witnessed action consequences, without supplying the task-phase bit, while preserving A and cold-restoring in one same native address?
scope: Fresh synthetic development only, not protected original-world first-use or canonical model continuation

hidden_generator.mode: balanced 16/16 independently in FIT and HELD per task
hidden_generator.false_cues: balanced 8/8 within each task,split,true-mode stratum independent random shuffle

hypotheses.selection: stage A on four source candidate cues; update each exact candidate model with B witnessed consequence batch; accept exactly one survivor; zero or multiple survivors abstain
hypotheses.old_retention: Before-B A readout fingerprint must match After-B A and cold-restored A for surviving exact same native checkpoint slot
hypotheses.no_postresult_replay: A original raw witness rows are not replayed in accumulator update B; accumulated sufficient constraints preserve previous support

matched_controls: independent fully fitted exact symbolic conditional counts on identically selected candidate mode/cue/action and both action source batches
independently fully fitted conventional depth-three binary tree on same selected factual cue and mode with identical FIT action-outcome rows
full refit original NativeContextBasis(context_bits=2) with both source batches and same discovered cue
mode+action only, ignoring any regime cue, counts trained on A+B (negative control)
phase provided oracle reference only, not included in superiority comparison and not candidate input
negative_controls: no regime-separating source property -> all hypothesis updates reject
two equal regime-separating candidate predicates -> selection abstains
missing or conflicting factual cue -> abstain
intervention labels not recoverable from factual Q/P/Q alone
same-slot parent checkpoint and original archived joint/source unchanged

qualification.focused: source-only negative controls on Ubuntu and Windows
qualification.full: root+contributor+G29 mandatory final exact candidate on both OS
qualification.historical: reuse already-consumed archived historical image and Amalgam checkpoint in existing real-source-compatibility workflow; original source blobs pinned

engineering_go: 6 of 6 unique cue roles from FIT public facts+witnesses, all held native consequences correct and full coverage, 0 A return readout drift, exact original historical and archived Amalgam SHA preservation, candidate factual/native cold restore, all qualification jobs success
scientific_go: native held Brier >= 0.01 better than each equally informed exact-symbolic/conventional/full-native-refit control on independently authorized original-world heldout, zero retention loss, matched information/actions/cost
inference_limit: This tests detection of a source-visible synthetic regime cue and a preregistered degree-1 relation class; neither new autonomous world intervention nor full causal discovery, language grounding, real knowledge or owner-accepted continuous model training
stop: one frozen development trial; no threshold, source generator, seed, held cohort, or strong-control alteration after reveal; preserve failures
